Modern PHP SDK for DataCite REST API using Saloon. Supports DOI registration, metadata management, and retrieval.

Use PHP 8.4+ syntax only  
Add `declare(strict_types=1);` to every PHP file  
Make all classes final unless inheritance is required  
Use readonly properties wherever possible  
Use constructor property promotion  
Use typed properties and return types  
Follow PSR-12 coding standards  
Never use `var_dump()` or `dd()` in production code  

Namespaces: `VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk`, `.Data`, `.Requests`, `.Enums`  
`DataCite.php` is the main client entry point.  
DTOs are `final readonly`; all responses use Data DTOs.  
Requests are `final`, extend `Saloon\Http\Request`, and use `RequiresMemberAuth` for member-only operations.  
Enums are backed enums with string or int values.  
Use traits from `Traits/`, including `HasPaginationParams`, `HasFieldParams`, `HasIdParams`.  
Use typed arrays in DocBlocks: `<REDACTED_USER> DoiObject[]`  
Follow existing naming conventions in Data/ classes.

Public API (default): read-only GET, no auth. Member API: POST/PUT/DELETE and member data; add:
`use VincentAuger\DataCiteSdk\Traits\Requests\RequiresMemberAuth;`

CreateDOI requires member API authentication:
```php
final class CreateDOI extends Request
use RequiresMemberAuth;  // Enforces member auth requirement
protected Method $method = Method::POST;
```

Run these commands before committing:
`composer test`
`composer lint`
`composer test:unit`
`composer test:types`
`composer refactor`
